conf.description: DMARC failure (ruf/ARF) per-row JSON from parsedmarc: arrival_date to email.delivery_timestamp/_time, nested sample object flattened into email.* with attachments normalized to parallel arrays, sample.body dropped outright and _raw dropped per recommendations.direct.cribl's redaction-first framing for this highest-risk dataset.

conf.comment: dmarc-reports / failure / json. Same hand-built pipeline family as aggregate -- no dmarc integration/pack exists. Per recommendations.direct.cribl, redaction is the primary job here: sample.body is dropped outright (explicit instruction, not masked), and _raw is dropped too since it would otherwise carry the same attacker-supplied body/headers the recommendation says no consumer needs in full -- a deliberate extension beyond the literal direct-route text, which is silent on _raw but repeats the same redaction-first framing as the guarded route. Unlike aggregate, this dataset's own parsing.notes says parsedmarc emits sample as a genuinely NESTED object, so sample.* dotted names are read via bracket chains, not treated as flat dotted keys. event.outcome is NOT derived from authentication_results: it is unparsed, receiver-formatted free text with no single grammar, so no parse was invented -- left as a raw custom field only (gap, see README).

functions.description: record approach, redaction decisions, and the flat-vs-nested contrast with the aggregate dataset
parse the per-row ARF-derived JSON document parsedmarc ships to the collector

derived/computed fields read from ORIGINAL vendor names before the rename batch: RFC 5322 arrival_date parse, nested sample.subject/headers bracket reads (Message-ID has a hyphen so it cannot be a rename target), dataset/category tags
batch every clean flat-key status:mapped/partial/unmapped field with no further transform

normalize sample.attachments (object-or-array) into parallel email.attachments.file.name/hash.sha256 arrays, then delete the fully-consumed sample object plus arrival_date and _raw (sample.body never makes it out since it lives inside the deleted sample object and was never copied)
Re-nest flat dotted keys (data-maps canonical step)
